notes.title: Environment Update
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hey Hunters! I'm so excited to share with you the latest updates and news, as well as the future plans of this game![/h2][/b]

[h3]As a solo indie developer, it takes a lot of time, passion, and late nights to bring Ravenhille to life. Your support means the world to me, and every comment, wishlist, and bit of feedback helps shape the dark, twisted world.[/h3]

[h2]In this update you will find:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]New environments
[*] NEW NPC: Cartographer: Now you can see your location in your map and much more!
[*] Visual/Light changes. (My main focus was to make it more eerie and atmospheric while making sure everything is balanced.)
[*] New models and assets.
[*] Fixed more bugs[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]New Environments[/b][/h1]

[b][h2]CAVES[/h2][/b]

[b][i]and more![/i][/b]

[h3][b]The update is planned to release this week![/b][/h3]

[b][h2]What will be next?[/h2][/b]

[u][b][h3]Steam Next Fest is around the corner, so I do not have much time left. I've gathered all my thoughts and keep improving the demo, hoping I can gain more wishlists and players.[/h3][/b][/u]

[b]In the coming months, I’ll be focusing on expanding the world, adding deeper lore, and making sure the player experience is great. There's so much more to uncover in the forest, and trust me - things are only going to get darker from here.[/b]

Thank you for joining me on this journey. Stay sharp, keep your lanterns lit, and remember:

The hunters came before. They did not return.

See you in Ravenhille.

notes.title: Echoes of the Deep Update
notes.content:
🩸 Ravenhille Update – "Echoes of the Deep"
The curse spreads. New creatures roam the forest. Something stirs beneath the ground...
This update brings new dangers, secrets, and tools to survive the horrors of Ravenhill.

Patch Notes:

More monsters (dog, spider, blob)

!SUMMON A DEMON BY YOURSELF NOW!

Monster spawner system

New caves and puzzles

Map rework (access it from the quick menu – Key: Q), includes a mini player marker and the ability to place pins. Further improvements are planned

New items

New villager: Medic – he can heal you (find him in the forest)

New start screen

More models

More optimizations

More UI improvements

More animations

More bug fixes

notes.title: MUSHROOM UPDATE
notes.content:
Mushroom system has been reworked - they now have special effects when eaten.
The new JOURNAL SYSTEM has arrived - you can access it from your inventory, under the CRAFT button.

More bug fixes

Changes in the village and forest

Jumping system rework - BHOP has been removed

Randomized sounds for the Beast - higher chance to make it run away

Tutorials appear when entering a new section

Camera movement added to the villager in the church

The player has thoughts throughout the game

Added SHADOW and FXAA settings

More collusion

More optimizations
